notes.title: The Dreadful Whispers is out!
notes.content:
[h1][b]My first commercial game is now available for everyone to play on Windows![/b][/h1]

I (Noa Calice) made this game completely on my own as the artist, programmer and designer alongside Dave Allen who composed the game's haunting, beautiful music!

Get ready to explore a twisted world filled with monsters, whispers, tortured characters, golden mountains and more!
Will you defeat your inner demons or be crippled with regret?

Enjoy :)!
